stop_rules: One fresh owned fixture only; preserve every failure as this attempt outcome; zero retries.
Source dispatch is one focused A chord with 2 s authority; never replay, regardless of source outcome.
If source action is not UNKNOWN with release unconfirmed, stop before recovery/followup and preserve result.
Verify exact producer absence before at most one public orphan recovery. Keep old action UNKNOWN, task_success null, replay denied.
Stop and retain fixture/fence on any target identity, foreground, recovery release, neutral readback, 2 s horizon, or fence uncertainty.
After recovery, require new Computer Use exact-window activation, independent HWND/PID foreground probe, fresh observation and fresh target generation before one distinct B action.
Only followup B may pass the independent task oracle; it must be tied to exact followup call/operation/generation and a char-B event within that dispatch interval, with fixture state ab.
Close fixture only after followup action release and task effect are independently verified; otherwise preserve it and report STOP.
No model/provider, efficiency, MAP01, general reliability, preview graduation, or original-action task-success claim.

trial.followup_task: After verified orphan recovery and a fresh observation/generation, append B; independent oracle requires exactly one new WM_CHAR B event within the new dispatch interval and fixture state ab.

trials.followup_task: After verified orphan recovery and a fresh observation/generation, append B; independent oracle requires exactly one new WM_CHAR B event within the new dispatch interval and fixture state ab.

workload: Two-stage native Win32 fixture: first public A action schedules factual delayed a at 6s under a 2s authority lease, then one public orphan recovery, then a fresh-generation public B action whose exact task effect is independently certified; the source action remains UNKNOWN and never replayed.
